paragraphs.text: Pilot is a creature type that was introduced in Kaladesh for those that drive vehicles or other modes of transportation.

Pilots are proficient at crewing Vehicles . Creatures with the type generally have an ability that care about Vehicles, but the breadth of design means the abilities can't be summarized easily. There is also an associated typal land , Mech Hangar .
An ability that is triggered by becoming tapped (eight Pilots)
An improved Crewing capacity (seven Pilots, plus many Pilot token makers)
Granting an ability or stat boost when crewing a Vehicle (six Pilots)
Passively granting an ability or a stat boost to all Vehicles (six Pilots)
Pilots are primarily red and white .

Several cards from Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty and its accompanying commander set create pilot tokens that crew vehicles as if their power were two greater. Later on, Aetherdrift introduced pilot tokens which are identical to their Kamigawan predecessors except that their ability now additionally functioned when saddling Mounts . However, the older pilots aren't to be errata 'd. This same additional text occurred on several Pilot creatures, and some abilities of Pilots also referred to Mounts.

With the introduction of the type, the decision was originally made to not retroactively apply it to Goblin Test Pilot from Dragon's Maze because it can't crew vehicles. However, this change was reversed, and the creature type was added with the rules update for Aether Revolt .

Since the introduction of Universes Beyond , Pilot as a type has become less mechanically defined, with many of their pilots being known as such in their source material but without such a reference on their cards.
